title: FeedCourier Plugin Registry Manifest (Protocol v1)
description: Strict manifest schema for plugins listed in the ElleryHe/FeedCourier-Plugins marketplace registry.

id.description: Globally unique lowercase plugin identifier (2–64 chars, lowercase letters/digits/hyphens/underscores). Must match registry/<id>.json.

name.description: Human-readable plugin display name shown in the FeedCourier WebUI and documentation site.

version.description: Semantic Version (SemVer 2.0.0) of this plugin release.

api_version.description: FeedCourier Plugin Protocol version. Must be "1".

kind.description: Plugin kind: builtin (compiled into FeedCourier), processor (on_render/on_delivered bridge), channel (custom delivery channel bridge), external (third-party), or coming_soon.

runtime.description: Execution runtime: builtin (in-process Rust) or bridge (out-of-process HTTP Bridge Protocol v1 sidecar).

category.description: Marketplace category used for filtering in the WebUI and docs site.

icon.description: Lucide icon slug rendered on marketplace cards (e.g., "link", "bell", "sparkles", "shield").

description.description: Concise single-paragraph summary of what the plugin does.

homepage.description: HTTPS documentation or project homepage URL.

image.description: Optional OCI/Docker container image reference for deploying a bridge sidecar.

compose_snippet.description: Optional Docker Compose YAML snippet showing how to run the bridge sidecar alongside FeedCourier.

hooks.description: Protocol v1 lifecycle hooks implemented by this plugin (required non-empty for builtin/processor plugins; optional for channel plugins).

account_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema describing account-level configuration fields for channel plugins.

destination_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema describing destination-level configuration fields for channel plugins.

capabilities.description: Optional channel adapter capabilities metadata (e.g. supports_html, max_text_len).
